summary.en: An Arc-inspired native document editor built with Go and MyGo, combining rich-text editing with Markdown workflows.
summary.zh-CN: 受 Arc 启发的原生文档编辑器，使用 Go 与 MyGo 构建，将富文本编辑与 Markdown 写作习惯结合。

description.en: ArcMD brings Arc-inspired spaces, a vertical sidebar, and global favorites to a local-first rich-text editor built with Go and MyGo Native UI. It supports Markdown import/export, tables, code blocks, backlinks, full-text search, and split editing for up to four documents; the project is currently in early preview.
description.zh-CN: ArcMD 使用 Go 与 MyGo Native UI 原生构建，以 Arc 风格的多彩空间、竖向侧边栏和全局收藏组织本地文档。支持 Markdown 导入导出、表格、代码块、双链、全文搜索，以及最多四篇文档的分屏编辑；项目目前处于早期预览阶段。
